_comment: SMOKE config for the core_v3 family -- a handful of cells that PROVE the family parses, expands, threads keyed==run, and runs end-to-end with the Section-1 reconciled chi2. It exercises the new core knobs: virialized Option-A grid (finer vir_n_nodes=40 for speed) + GRF sphere support + node_force_law='bounded' + node_softening_gpc=1.0 + Section-4 adaptive substep (threshold=2.0, substeps=8) + ternary co-fit. NOT a physics result: 120 particles is far below convergence -- it only validates the pipeline. n_steps=273 is the leapfrog-stability FLOOR for the 10.9 Gyr run (dt<0.05 Gyr), not the production 546. Factorial axes: 2 geometries (cube26 control + virialized Option A) x 2 low M, S co-fit over a tiny [3..6] band. Run: python sweep.py --config sweeps/core_v3_smoke.json
